```sql
WITH matched_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
line_items AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id, pv.id AS variant_id, ol.order_id, ol.quantity, ol.line_total_cents
      FROM matched_orders mo
      JOIN order_lines ol      ON ol.order_id = mo.id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
),
per_product_order AS (
    SELECT product_id, order_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS quantity,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS revenue_cents
      FROM line_items
     GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
per_product AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)                AS order_count,
           sum(quantity)::bigint   AS quantity,
           sum(revenue_cents)      AS revenue_cents
      FROM per_product_order
     GROUP BY product_id
),
variant_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM line_items) dv
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN variant_counts vc ON vc.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN products p        ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY pp.quantity DESC, pp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De productgegevens worden pas na de aggregatie gejoind, zodat de dure sort op (product, order) veel smallere rijen verwerkt en de externe sort op schijf waarschijnlijk vermijdbaar is. De `count(DISTINCT o.id)` wordt vervangen door een count op unieke (product, order)-paren, en `quantity` wordt met `::bigint` gecast zodat de kolomtypes gelijk blijven aan het origineel. De verwachte winst is niet gemeten; controleer dit met EXPLAIN ANALYZE op de representatieve parameters.
